source: OBSERVER_TEST_PREREG_FROZEN.md (from OBSERVER_TEST_PREREG_DRAFT.md, approved by Pablo 2026-10-20 ~11:40 CDMX: Rule A primary). Mechanical transcription; if it disagrees with the frozen document, the document wins.

C.note: sign undetermined - not testable by sign test; reported as such, no computation

mechanical_exclusion: effective k = k_row - k_ref for rows predicted as a ratio to a reference mass (reference structure read from prereg/gct_formulas.json encodings[*].R); a reference with no declared k (null) makes the row 'none'; a row or reference whose k is 0 because the sign is unknown (unknown_sign_zero) makes the row 'none'; rows with effective k = 0 do not predict. th12: the GCT formula adds theta13/5 at its observed value; under Rule A both angles shift by -eps so the residual shift is -eps*(th12 - th13/5)/th12 < 0: effective sign of th12 = sign(k_th12) (draft §2). Dimensionless/angle rows have no reference.
residual: r_i = y_i / pred_i - 1 with y_i from prereg/targets.json rows[*].y and pred_i = prereg/gct_formulas.json phi_values_primary_convention[*].value (alpha_inv = class E bilayer encoding). NOTE: the stored field 'r' in that file is pred/y - 1 (opposite sign) and is NOT used.

decision.A_sign_test: A = #agreeing rows of n; one-sided binomial p = P(X >= A | n, 1/2)
decision.eps_hat: median over predicting rows of r_j / k_j
decision.LOO: eps_-i = max(0, median_{j != i} r_j / k_j); improved if |r_i - eps_-i * k_i| < |r_i|; I_LOO = #improved
decision.p_rand: fraction of all 2^n sign patterns over the same rows (same pipeline) with I_LOO >= Rule A's (ties against Rule A)
decision.p_sector: rank of Rule A among the 2^5 sector-coherent patterns (one sign per group, groups {alpha_inv}, {alphas_inv} (split from alpha_inv), {sin2thW}, {s12,s23,s13}, {th12,th13}): fraction of the 32 patterns with I_LOO >= Rule A's (ties against)
decision.SUPPORTED: A >= 7 AND eps_hat > 0 AND I_LOO >= 6 AND p_rand <= 0.05 (for n = 8)
report_only: count restricted to rows with |r_i| > 2 sigma_hat_i (sigma_hat_i = sigma_i / |y_i|)
Rule B sign test (n=3, cannot pass at 0.05)
